items.note: Resolved against the accepted rationale: blueprint lines 101-105 retain only environment/resource constraints and general timing instructions; the former parenthetical task prompts are absent. intake.md lines 729-746 likewise retain objective-to-format assignments and scheduling without task-specific expected outcomes, tests, keys, rubrics, or solutions.

Resolved by the rationale's allowed alternative: intake.md line 449 explicitly says logging is not a project action, remains skim/reference, and the scaffold handler requires no learner-authored logging.

Resolved: objective o1 now separates the default aggregate health status from explicitly enabling management.endpoint.health.show-components, states component/detail visibility defaults to never, and adds a trusted-caller exposure caveat before reading the database contributor status.

Resolved: objective o2 now distinguishes curated dependency management through spring-boot-dependencies/the starter parent from starters as convenient sets of managed dependencies, alongside auto-configuration and the embedded server.

Still open against the accepted rationale. The canonical rule at lines 469 and 489 was corrected to unquoted -Dtest=increment<N>.*, but the learner-outcome cells at lines 505, 515, 526, 538, and 548 still prescribe single-quoted -Dtest='incrementN.**'. Those stale commands retain the cmd.exe incompatibility and contradict the canonical selector. Replace every detailed occurrence with the same unquoted selector before module authors implement the plan.

Resolved within the reconciliation's explicit scope: intake.md lines 477-489 bind all six increments and the intervening FT5/FT7 briefs to one project, extension order, calendar rows, public-test packages/names, claimed fragments, minute plans, cumulative command, and no-container rule. Machine-readable overlay/package binding remains explicitly deferred to pep-t1-track-overlays as the rationale requires.

Resolved: each of the seven identified dynamic responses now records a canonical-text-v1 SHA-256 and the exact canonicalization method in sectionsUsed, while preserving URL, retrieval time, and raw hash; intake.md line 755 records equality across two fetches and versioned-URL handling.
